description: This PHP class defines a TemplateDecimal class that extends a TemplateFloat class, representing a decimal field for templates in SuiteCRM. It includes methods to determine the database type based on length and precision, and contains class-level properties for default values.

classes.name: TemplateDecimal
classes.description: A class representing a decimal template field, extending TemplateFloat, with methods to manage database type definitions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: get_db_type
methods.description: Returns the database column type string for a decimal, based on length and precision properties.
